verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that gives AI agents tools to interact with the Stripe API (docs-12), and a probe confirms the official MCP docs page at docs.stripe.com/mcp (probe-4). This lets an agent connect to the platform Stripe Identity runs on. Missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server exposes Identity-specific tools (e.g., verification sessions or results), connection/auth setup details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
